<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Disasters and accidents
*A [[BNSF Railway]] freight train with 33 oil tanker cars derails in [[Lyon County, Iowa]]; some of the crude leaks into the rain-swollen [[Rock River (Big Sioux River)|Rock River]]. A mandatory evacuation was ordered; there are no injuries. [https://www.desmoinesregister.com/story/news/crime-and-courts/2018/06/22/northwest-iowa-flooding-little-rock-river-train-derailment-mandatory-evacuation-lyon-county-doon/724618002/ (''Des Moines Register'')] 
*Police say the safety driver of an [[Uber]] self-driving car that fatally struck a pedestrian in [[Arizona]] was distracted by watching a TV show on her phone. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-uber-selfdriving-crash/uber-cars-safety-driver-streamed-tv-show-before-fatal-crash-police-idUSKBN1JI0LB (Reuters)]
;International relations
*[[Trump administration family separation policy]]
**The [[United Nations]] [[United Nations Human Rights Council|Human Rights Council]] issues a condemnation of the separation of migrant children from their parents, saying it "may amount to torture", and the recent executive order "does not address the situation of those children who have already been pulled away from their parents." [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/un-trump-children-family-torture-separation-border-mexico-border-ice-detention-a8411676.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**[[Malta]] refuses to accept 234 African immigrants from the [[Netherlands|Dutch]] ship ''Lifeline''. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-europe-migrants-italy/italy-says-malta-not-taking-in-migrant-ship-is-inhumane-idUSKBN1JI1FS (Reuters)]
*Aftermath of the [[2018 North Korea–United States summit]], [[United States Forces Korea]]
**[[United States Department of Defense|The Pentagon]] announces the suspension of joint military exercises with [[South Korea]], including the [[Ulchi-Freedom Guardian]] and marine training exercises. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2018/06/23/asia-pacific/pentagon-says-u-s-will-indefinitely-halt-select-military-exercises-south-korea-talks-north-progress/ (''The Japan Times'')]
;Law and crime
*''[[Carpenter v. United States]]''
**The [[Supreme Court of the United States|U.S. Supreme Court]], by a 5–4 vote, rules law enforcement are required to obtain a search warrant to gather location data from cell phone companies. [https://gizmodo.com/cops-need-a-warrant-to-collect-your-phone-location-data-1827050891 (''Gizmodo'')]
*[[Human rights in Venezuela]]
**A report from the [[Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights]] accuses the [[Venezuela]]n government of allowing its security forces to participate in hundreds of [[extrajudicial killings]] over the past year. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/06/rule-law-virtually-absent-venezuela-180622201430098.html (Al Jazeera)] 
*[[2017 New York City truck attack]]
**Prosecutors in the [[United States]] charge [[Sayfullo Saipov]] with a further six counts of attempted murder, in addition to the 22 other offences already charged in connection to a [[vehicle-ramming attack]] in [[New York City|New York]]. Saipov enters pleas of not guilty. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/06/22/us/nyc-terror-attack-new-charges/index.html (CNN)]
*A court in [[Jakarta]] convicts cleric Aman Abdurrahman of inciting others to commit terror attacks in support of [[ISIS]] and [[Capital punishment in Indonesia|sentence him to death]]. [http://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2018/06/22/pro-is-cleric-gets-death-for-inspiring-terror-attacks-in-indonesia.html (''The Jakarta Post'')]
*Two men are jailed in the [[United Kingdom]] for looting historical items from [[World War I]] shipwreck [[HMS Hermes|HMS ''Hermes'']] and selling them for scrap. [http://home.bt.com/news/uk-news/pair-jailed-for-looting-shipwreck-11364279688078 (BT)]
;Sports
*[[2018 Mediterranean Games]]
**The inauguration ceremony of the [[2018 Mediterranean Games|XVIIIth edition of the Mediterranean Games]] takes place in [[Tarragona]], [[Spain]]. [http://www.elmundo.es/cataluna/2018/06/22/5b2d2032ca47413e0c8b45aa.html (''El Mundo'')]
